mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, link, student_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{link}, #{studentId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE AND is_archived = FALSE
SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_archived = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
UPDATE notifications SET is_archived = TRUE, is_read = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, s.full_name AS student_name, u.full_name AS therapist_name FROM therapy_sessions t JOIN students s ON s.id = t.student_id JOIN users u ON u.id = t.therapist_id WHERE t.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND t.start_time >= NOW() AND t.start_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY t.start_time
